card.what: Teak cabin-top grab rail cut from one plank: arched hand holes open to the deck between tall feet, sloped ends, a rounded grip, teak bungs over the bolts
card.boats: J/22 hero and light J/22 (three holes, 0.84 m), Catalina 22, Corsair 880 and Catalina 30 (build_fleet.py, four or more holes)
card.distance: arm's reach; the crew grabs it going forward
card.before: kit HandrailTeak from bk_parts (Oct 2026): a flat bar on square feet; on the J/22 hero a 1.09 m bar on five blocks

references.use: the J/22's rails: three hand holes a side (the aft end is half hidden by a line, so a fourth is possible), tall broad feet, arched holes, long sloped ends, dark weathered teak (IMG_9224, project files only)

references.url: Whitecap / West Marine teak handrails: 3 loops 33 in, 4 loops 43 in, 2-3/8 in high, 1 in across, holes 10-1/16 in apart
references.note: numbers only; the J/22's rail reads chunkier than the catalogue's

sizes.name: Height
sizes.source: Bean's photo reads taller than the catalogue's 60 mm; the blind reviewers asked for it each round
